_published_faq.name: How do I add Expedia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Expedia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.expedia.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Expedia MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Expedia scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Expedia MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expedia provides these MCP tools: search_hotels, search_flights, and get_hotel_pdp_offers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Expedia?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Expedia in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Expedia does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
